subject.statement: Do Kwon is currently in custody in Montenegro.

summary: Do Kwon was arrested in Montenegro in March 2023 and remained there while extradition proceedings continued. By mid‑2025, Montenegro approved his extradition to the United States and he was transferred to U.S. custody, so he is no longer in Montenegro custody as of October 2026.
